summary: template options: unsafe_writes, validate with %s before installing, and custom variable_start_string/variable_end_string delimiters.
questions: How do I validate a templated config before it goes live?
How do I change the {{ }} delimiters in a template?

answer_card.title: template validate and variable delimiters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `validate`: command with `%s` run on temp file (no shell features)
- `variable_start_string` (`{{`) / `variable_end_string` (`}}`)
- `unsafe_writes` (false)
